coupling: The first index.c commit leaves the Stream node's right link for index_tree_append() to initialize. The next commit makes the new prepend path preserve that link when inserting the first node, relying on index_stream_init() to have initialized it. Either edit by itself is safe; together, lzma_index_init() leaves a caller-allocator-supplied pointer in the tree and lzma_index_end() dereferences it. The initialization contract spans both commits, so a reviewer must reconcile both sides of it.
